provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Alphabet review
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify all letters Aa to Zz.
The pupils should be able to sort vowels from consonants.

Introduction:
Today we review all letters we learned last term.
We will play a sorting game with vowels and consonants.

Content:
Letters Aa to Zz are our alphabet friends.
Vowels are A E I O U. They make special sounds.
Consonants are all other letters. They make different sounds.
Let us sing the alphabet song together.

Class activity:
Give pupils letter cards. They sort vowels and consonants into two baskets.

Evaluation questions:
What is the first letter?
What is the last letter?
Name one vowel.
Name one consonant.

Summary:
We have reviewed all letters and sorted vowels from consonants.

topics.title: Short a word families
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read words with an, at, ap.
The pupils should be able to build words with letter cards.

Introduction:
Last week we reviewed all letters.
Today we learn to make words with short a sounds.

Content:
Word families are letters that go together.
An family: an, can, fan, man
At family: at, cat, hat, bat
Ap family: ap, cap, map, tap
We sound each letter and blend them together.

Class activity:
Give pupils letter cards. They build words like cat, fan, and map.

Evaluation questions:
What sound does a make?
Build the word bat.
Build the word map.

Summary:
We can build words with short a sounds.

topics.title: Short e families
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read words with ed, en, et.
The pupils should be able to spell words like pen and hen.

Introduction:
Last week we learned short a word families.
Today we learn short e word families.

Content:
Ed family: ed, bed, red
En family: en, hen, pen, ten
Et family: et, net, pet, wet
We sound each letter and blend them.

Class activity:
Pupils draw pictures of words like hen and pen.

Evaluation questions:
What sound does e make?
Spell the word hen.
Spell the word net.

Summary:
We can read and spell short e words.

topics.title: Short i families
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read words with id, ig, in, ip.
The pupils should be able to build the word wig.

Introduction:
Last week we learned short e word families.
Today we learn short i word families.

Content:
Id family: id, hid, lid
Ig family: ig, big, pig, dig
In family: in, pin, tin, win
Ip family: ip, hip, lip, sip

Class activity:
Pupils build words with letter cards. They make pig and wig.

Evaluation questions:
What sound does i make?
Build the word pig.
Build the word wig.

Summary:
We can read and build short i words.

topics.title: Short o families
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read words with og, op, ot.
The pupils should be able to spell the word top.

Introduction:
Last week we learned short i word families.
Today we learn short o word families.

Content:
Og family: og, dog, log, fog
Op family: op, hop, mop, pop
Ot family: ot, hot, pot, dot
We sound each letter and blend them.

Class activity:
Pupils hop like frogs when they read ot words.

Evaluation questions:
What sound does o make?
Spell the word hop.
Spell the word top.

Summary:
We can read and spell short o words.

topics.title: Short u families
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read words with ub, ug, un, ut.
The pupils should be able to spell the word sun.

Introduction:
Last week we learned short o word families.
Today we learn short u word families.

Content:
Ub family: ub, cub, tub, rub
Ug family: ug, bug, rug, hug
Un family: un, fun, run, sun
Ut family: ut, cut, hut, nut
We sound each letter and blend them.

Class activity:
Pupils run in place when they read un words.

Evaluation questions:
What sound does u make?
Spell the word run.
Spell the word sun.

Summary:
We can read and spell short u words.

topics.title: Blending drill
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to blend ten words.
The pupils should be able to play the reading ladder game.

Introduction:
Last week we learned short u word families.
Today we practice blending sounds to read words.

Content:
Blending means putting sounds together to read a word.
We say each sound quickly and blend them.
Example: c-a-t makes cat.
We practice with ten different words.

Class activity:
Play reading ladder game. Pupils read words from simple to hard.

Evaluation questions:
Blend c-a-t.
Blend r-u-n.
Blend p-i-g.

Summary:
We can blend sounds to read words.

topics.title: Simple sentences
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read the sentence.
The pupils should be able to copy the sentence.

Introduction:
Last week we practiced blending words.
Today we learn to read simple sentences.

Content:
A sentence is a group of words that makes sense.
It starts with a capital letter and ends with a period.
The sentence is: The hen has ten eggs.
We read it together.

Class activity:
Pupils copy the sentence in their notebooks.

Evaluation questions:
What is a sentence?
Read the sentence.
Copy the sentence.

Summary:
We can read and copy simple sentences.

topics.title: Sight words 1
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read sight words.
The pupils should be able to use words in sentences.

Introduction:
Last week we learned simple sentences.
Today we learn sight words.

Content:
Sight words are words we know by heart.
We do not sound them out. We just read them.
The sight words are: the, and, a, I, to, is
We practice reading them quickly.

Class activity:
Play sight word bingo. Pupils mark words on their cards.

Evaluation questions:
What are sight words?
Read the word the.
Use the word is in a sentence.

Summary:
We can read sight words quickly.

topics.title: Revision and reading race
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to play word family relay.
The pupils should be able to play sight word bingo.

Introduction:
This week we revise all we learned this term.
We will play fun games with words.

Content:
We review all word families and sight words.
We practice reading quickly and accurately.
We play games to show what we know.

Class activity:
Play word family relay. Pupils race to build words.

Evaluation questions:
What word family is cat in?
What is a sight word?
Read this word quickly: the

Summary:
We had fun reviewing all our words.
